title: EA-CORPORA-01/11 — The Papyri Panel: Sappho Circle and the Apocalypse Papyri (DCLP), Seated
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: Seats a thirty-item papyrological panel from the papyri/idp.data mirror of the Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri: the twenty-eight Sappho-circle records surfaced by author-search — P.Oxy 21.2288 and its kin, PSI 15.1470, the Aeolic-lyric fragments — plus the two named Apocalypse papyri: 𝔓18 (P.Oxy 8.1079, transcription seated) and 𝔓115 (P.Oxy 66.4499, catalog-grade, no transcription upstream). Each record kept as-fetched with an edition-div extraction where DCLP carries one (gaps and supplied readings marked), a panel catalog, and the honest scope note: DCLP transcription coverage is partial by upstream design, and editio-princeps public-domain scans are queued for the deep texts. Eleventh seat under EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498).
substrate: Built by TACHYON (Claude substrate) under MANUS direction per EA-OMEGA-BUILD-01 (#1498); rulings and governance the author's.
axn_reading: Growth -> Direction -> Threshold -> Force -> Foundation -> Foundation
